import hashlib, importlib.util, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/'evidence/mainline/engineering/05-water'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('water_fresh_check',base/'run_fixtures.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
old=json.loads((base/'fixtures-e8555f76/fresh-read-receipt.json').read_text())
new=json.loads((base/'fixtures-122f73bd/fresh-read-receipt.json').read_text())
comparisons={}
for key in new:
    first=base/'fixtures-e8555f76'/key
    second=base/'fixtures-122f73bd'/key
    fresh=module.fresh_check(second)
    assert fresh==new[key], key+' fresh receipt changed'
    old_rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (first/'private-state.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    new_rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (second/'private-state.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert old_rows==new_rows, key+' semantic state trajectory changed after power integration'
    assert (first/'balances.jsonl').read_bytes()==(second/'balances.jsonl').read_bytes(), key+' balance file changed'
    comparisons[key]={'semantic_private_states_identical':True,'balance_bytes_identical':True,'fresh_read_pass':True}
frozen={}
for name in ('configs/full-facility-mainline-v1.json','configs/full-facility-mainline-v2.json','configs/materials/reference-r134a-saturation.json','src/aegis_dc/__main__.py','src/aegis_dc/scenario.py'):
    expected=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','0ee160cdcdbd195acf35d552abd8040ef7e55b5c:'+name],text=True).strip()
    actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object','--no-filters',name],text=True).strip()
    assert expected==actual, name+' changed'
    frozen[name]={'unchanged_git_blob':actual,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
acceptance=json.loads((base/'acceptance-122f73bd/summary.json').read_text())
assert acceptance['overall']=='PASS' and acceptance['tests']['run']==206 and acceptance['tests']['executed']==204
assert acceptance['tests']['failures']==acceptance['tests']['errors']==0 and len(acceptance['tests']['optional_neural_skips'])==2 and not acceptance['tests']['unexpected_skips']
checks={}
for directory in sorted(base.glob('[0-9][0-9]-*')):
    if directory.name.startswith('25-'): continue
    receipt=json.loads((directory/'receipt.json').read_text())
    checks[directory.name]=receipt['exit_code']
failures=[name for name,code in checks.items() if code!=0]
assert len(failures)==8, failures
files={path.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(base.rglob('*')) if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and not any(part.startswith('25-final') for part in path.parts)}
receipt={'schema':'aegisdc-water-engineering-receipt-v1','classification':'FINITE_ENGINEERING_VERIFICATION_ONLY','implementation_commit':'8db1e95a','final_run_source_commit':'122f73bd7fcd38fb18d3911227a58aaf8aafaafd','root_acceptance':'PENDING','mainline_status':'active','M1_status':'in_progress','frozen_inputs':frozen,'full_acceptance':{'path':'evidence/mainline/engineering/05-water/acceptance-122f73bd/summary.json','discovered':206,'executed':204,'optional_neural_skips':2,'unexpected_skips':0,'failures':0,'errors':0,'original_files_valid':20},'checks_exit_code':checks,'failed_engineering_checks_preserved':failures,'cross_integration_fresh_comparisons':comparisons,'prior_engineering_files_sha256':files,'research_trials':0,'model_calls':0,'training_calls':0,'field_calibration':'PENDING','scientific_gain':'NOT_ESTABLISHED'}
with (base/'receipt-122f73bd.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'fresh_run_count':len(comparisons),'all_semantic_states_and_balance_files_preserved':True,'unchanged_input_count':len(frozen),'prior_engineering_files_hashed':len(files),'failed_engineering_checks_preserved':failures,'full_acceptance':receipt['full_acceptance']},indent=2))
